scripts.build: python3 build-scripts/build-resources.py && npm --workspace launcher run build
scripts.test: npm --workspace launcher test && node --test kubejs-custom/test_items.cjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s resourcepacks -p 'test_*.py' && python3 -m unittest discover -s client-pack -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && npm --workspace launcher run package:mac
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npm --workspace launcher run package:win
